evidence.notes: Removing a populated org-cache key returns true.
Removing a populated session-cache key returns true.
The local base email value is directly constructible.

source.content: Cache.Org.put('proof-org-remove', 'value'); System.assertEquals(true, Cache.Org.remove('proof-org-remove')); Cache.Session.put('proof-session-remove', 'value'); System.assertEquals(true, Cache.Session.remove('proof-session-remove')); Messaging.Email email = new Messaging.Email(); System.assertNotEquals(null, email);
